$comment: The expo-updates fingerprints of the binaries currently in users' hands.
An `eas update` only reaches a build whose fingerprint matches exactly;
publishing to any other value reports success and reaches zero devices,
with no error anywhere. scripts/verify-ota-target.mjs compares the working
tree against this file and refuses to publish on a mismatch.
Update this file in the same commit that ships a new binary, and never to
silence the preflight — a mismatch means the update cannot land, not that

android.$note: Built from main 1834d6e (EAS build a36b88ac) and submitted to the Play closed alpha 2026-09-05 (submission bf6781ae); promoted to production the same day (full rollout, in Play review). First binary with R8 on (#107): 80% obfuscation on Play, 23.7 MB install size, down 8.92 MB from 69. Also carries the push-token listener fix (#108) and the 0.1.4 bump (#109). Until the production review lands, most Android users still run 69 at 30288aed1e67034363dfc0af137eb93ae3aaae28.

ios.$note: Submitted to the TestFlight internal group 2026-09-04 (EAS build e4a31d8d, submission d42a3ff2, commit 0c664ec).
